'''Mike Shumaker''' (GEMP handle '''MGB''')<ref name="challonge2025">[https://challonge.com/51m1q7zu/standings 2025 SWCCG Retro GEMPC - Premiere - DS2 - Standings], Challonge (participant names with GEMP handles). Hosted snapshot: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/challonge/51m1q7zu-standings.html swccg.com]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014022459/https://swccg.com/snapshots/challonge/51m1q7zu-standings.html Internet Archive].</ref> finished '''#72''' at the [[2025 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].<ref name="talaga2025">[https://swccg.com/snapshots/email/2025-07-09-talaga-retro-gempc-final-standings.pdf Email from Andy Talaga to participants, "Innagurual Retro GEMPC SWCCG - Conclusion", 9 July 2025] (final standings for all 96 players; provided by Bill). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013203938/https://swccg.com/snapshots/email/2025-07-09-talaga-retro-gempc-final-standings.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> He also played the [[2014 Match Play Championship]], listed by surname only.<ref name="pc-rem">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/MPC-2014-Day-1-Main-Event.pdf 2014 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
